meta.name: dotcanvas
meta.description: Author and edit a Grida `.canvas` board — a `.canvas.json` manifest plus document files (references, generated images, notes) placed on an infinite canvas. Use when working on a `.canvas` bundle or arranging visuals/design work spatially. For a linear deck/presentation, use the `slides` skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在无限画布上编排视觉与设计素材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在自由画布上组织设计素材和灵感
copy.tagline_en: Arrange visuals and design assets on an infinite canvas
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to organize design assets and ideas on a freeform canvas

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以创建和编辑 Grida 的 .canvas 设计板——一个包含 .canvas.json 清单和文档文件的文件夹，文档可自由放置在无限画布上。Claude 会读写清单和文件，管理文档位置和尺寸。
howto.when: 当你想进行自由形式的视觉或设计工作（如海报、参考图收集），而不是线性演示时，可以要求 Claude 创建或编辑 .canvas 板。

say.text: 帮我创建一个海报.canvas 板，放一张参考图和一张生成的图片。
say.note: Claude 会创建文件夹和清单，并放置文档。

say.text: 把画布上的图片移到坐标 (100, 200) 并放大到 800x600。
say.note: Claude 会修改清单中的 layout 字段。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create and edit Grida .canvas design boards—a folder containing a .canvas.json manifest and document files placed on an infinite canvas. Claude reads/writes the manifest and files, managing document positions and sizes.
howto.when_en: When you want to work on freeform visual/design work (e.g., posters, reference collections) rather than a linear presentation, ask Claude to create or edit a .canvas board.

say_en.text: Create a poster.canvas board with one reference image and one generated image.
say_en.note: Claude will create the folder and manifest, and place documents.

say_en.text: Move the image on the canvas to coordinates (100, 200) and scale it to 800x600.
say_en.note: Claude will edit the layout in the manifest.
